status: prospective package operator probe; predictions derived before package execution

target.runtime_identity: Record resolved image ID, package inventory, compiler, linked libraries and source hashes; a fresh image is not the historic matrix runtime.

geometry: x in [-1,1], y,z in [0,1], orthogonal uniform cell-centred block; interface x=0 aligned with an internal face; fixed x walls and translational y/z cyclic patches

model.velocity: U=(0,tau*x/mu_side,0); scalar shear=U_y; positive prescribed kinematic mu; rho=1
model.scalar_equation: negative fvm::laplacian(muFace,shear)=0; no pressure, time advancement, interface advection or full momentum model
means: harmonic mean on the internal coefficient jump with initialized boundary values
model.gradient: Gauss linear; orthogonal snGrad; Gauss linear orthogonal laplacian
model.constant_control: constantControl=1 including fixed x walls, y/z cyclic, face coefficient uniformly one; assemble but do not solve
model.solver: shear PCG with DIC, tolerance 1e-12, relTol 0

records: Frozen harness commit, protocol, generator, utility, runner and every case-input hash before production execution
Cell centres/volumes/values; raw and boundary-completed matrix diagonal, source, internal upper/lower and all patch coefficients
All face centres/area vectors/owners/neighbours, coefficient, distance coefficient, snGrad, physical flux and matrix flux
Native scalar residual, independently reconstructed complete b-Au, oriented physical face balance, div(faceFlux)*V, and normalized SolverPerformance as separate quantities
Exact-nodal and solved shear states; estimated gradient tensors and arithmetic parent-product/separated explicit-correction face vectors and divergences

acceptance.run_integrity: Three cases, five named JSON snapshots each, normal end markers, container exit zero, all finite arrays, geometry/input hashes and image/platform match recorded values

constant_control.source_prediction: native residual = complete b-Au + sum_cyclic(boundaryCoeffs*u_neighbour); with this constant control it is 2*h per cell, h=2/nx
constant_control.disposition: OBSERVED or NOT_OBSERVED separately from physical/operator-quality gate; API contract/source-package identity and duplicate search are required before an upstream defect claim

predictions.explicit_correction: x-normal faces zero; y-normal correction vectors generally nonzero but paired divergence cancels; do not require all face vectors to vanish
predictions.estimated_gradient: kink-adjacent Gauss gradients differ from exact one-sided gradients; preserve both before/after rather than assuming equality

limits: This auxiliary interface probe does not replace or complete the original smooth 3D concentration benchmark or its AMR quality requirement.
No assertion of packaged-source/binary equivalence follows merely from an upstream pin; compare supplied package source hashes and record linked libraries.
Runtime/build failure is STOP/INCOMPLETE, not numerical quality FAIL.
The arithmetic interface effect is a known conditional diffusion-discretization control, not automatically an implementation defect.
Native residual discrepancy is a separate diagnostic candidate. No molecular ordering, constitutive-viscosity change or continuum blow-up follows.
The source prediction and scalar stencil were already analytically inspected; this is prospective execution validation, not a blinded discovery experiment.
